payload.text: **Estate coordination (hv, 26 Oct, decision 20):** the VCs are up, and hv starts builders only when their project is called. One project at a time runs its heavy work directly, with no slot desk, and a kovacs leg counts as heavy. While two projects overlap, their VCs send molt-vc START and END. Order: Molt, Devbin, Utilz, Intent, Gtools, Conflab, Laksa. kovacs-sysadm is reached by name over Remote Control.
